title: Designing an Evidence Trail for Agent Actions
subtitle: Connecting requests, policy decisions, execution, and observed state
description: I trace one synthetic agent action from its request to its observed effect, then examine what event hashes, snapshots, and replay can establish—and what needs additional verification.

title: When rules beat decision models
subtitle: Lessons from an executed tool-selection evaluation
description: I replaced a label-matching diagnostic with an executable support workflow. On 144 synthetic test episodes, the rules baseline outperformed the tested zero-shot model configurations.
